areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Photovoltaic installation in tax-administration buildings, with an indicator on increased own energy generation.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Upgrade of the agricultural monitoring system with socio-environmental cross-checks and cattle traceability, supporting ecological tax benefits and reduced deforestation.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Taxpayer registry integration with the national business-registration network and foreign-trade single-window integration improve the business environment.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Sustainable logistics plan sets procurement quotas for firms owned by women, persons with disabilities, ethnic and social minorities, and other vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Data-driven public-resource management aimed at better citizen services, with an indicator raising the share of online services.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: IT infrastructure and data-centre upgrades, unified analytics and AI architecture, and predictive machine-learning models for tax processes.

areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Actions only indirectly affect environmental sustainability; those with a specific fit are credited under 1.2, 1.5 and 1.10 instead.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Project has no basic sanitation actions.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Project has no integrated water-resources management actions.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Benefits accrue to taxpayers generally, not specifically to individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms; training actions do not directly affect formalization or public procurement access.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Project has no job and income actions for low-income and vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Project has no social infrastructure or facilities for these groups.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Leadership and diversity training could raise awareness but was not shown to produce effective gender or race equity; training audiences do not justify points here or in 1.10.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Could not be concluded that fiscal-education actions improve education conditions.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Project has no actions related to this criterion.
